__skeleton__.who_may_issue_the_real_document: A GENERATOR (no independent review required for the capture itself)
__skeleton__.why_a_generator_is_enough: Every field is a measurement of a GitHub API response plus a digest of repository bytes. NW-01's was produced by work/twentieth-forward/capture-owner-merge.mjs, which mirrors control-context-verifier-*/trusted-github.mjs verifyOwnerMergeArtifact. Nothing here is a decision, so self-issue is not self-certification.
__skeleton__.but: It is the ONLY one of the four that cannot exist before the M4 merge: merge.sha, merge.tree, merge.parents, pr.*, the three blob_sha values and the api_bundle digest are all properties of that merge.

approved_window.note: NW-01 recorded the M-merge window here, which differed from the accepted_binding window by 13 minutes (07:18:16 vs 07:05:16). Whether the NW-02 evidence should carry the M4 window or the M3-materialized accepted_binding window is open point 4 in NW02DraftNotes.md.

merge_timestamps.why: trusted-github.mjs:73 reads commit.commit.committer.date, and the M3 window_rule names not_before_source VERIFIED_OWNER_MERGE_COMMIT_COMMITTED_AT. The controller requires merged_at only to be present (:41) and never compares its value, so a delta is recorded rather than treated as a failure. Measured for M3/PR164: committed_at and merged_at were both 2026-09-13T05:45:14Z, delta 0.

verification_method.note: A second implementation of the same conditions, applied to API responses fetched by the caller. The controller performs its own verification at runtime through its pinned gh.exe; this does not substitute for it.
